simple.meaning: נֶדֶר (neder) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a promise (to God); also (concretely) a thing promised.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 60 times across Genesis, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Judges, and 10 more, beginning at Genesis 28:20. Its contexts include family line, flock, offering, sacrifice, kingship, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נֶדֶר (H5088).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: נֶדֶר (neder) / H5088 is traced through Genesis 28:20, Genesis 31:13, Leviticus 7:16, Leviticus 22:18 as a generated source-based concept entry.
